digest.component_or_area: rebar plan vocabulary and review system
propositions: The rebar plan vocabulary defines two headings — Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria — that carry identical semantics across all criteria gates, with no semantic axis distinguishing them

Success Criteria items written as plain bullets are invisible to _count_ac_items checklist detection, cannot receive the [operator-attested] tag, and bypass the P1 blocking floor, creating a tightening problem when collapsed
Criteria gates F1, G3, G7, and the completion verifier all pool Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria and apply one bar, with no SC-specific carve-outs

The collapse requires updating detector regexes, reviewer prompts, criteria routing, author guides, generated documentation, eval specs, and migrating 106 store tickets from SC bullets to AC checkboxes

Four false-positive matches must survive the migration: plan_review_T2.md (pilot metrics), plan_review_verifier.md and plan_review_verifier_agentic.md (dod_uncertifiable), verify_models.py (dod_uncertifiable), and O-RAN-SC vendor references

The epic's acceptance criteria contain unsatisfiable mutual contradictions that were discovered only during implementation and required post-plan amendments, revealing a process gap in plan-review validation
